title: Preventing Self-Siphonage in P-Traps
description: A P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block sewer gases from entering living spaces. However, if the trap arm drops vertically before reaching a vented drain line, momentum and atmospheric pressure cause the rushing water to siphon out the trap seal completely. To ensure the water seal remains intact, always maintain a minimum horizontal trap arm length before any vertical drop and connect directly to a properly sized vent pipe according to applicable local code standards.

Preventing Self-Siphonage in P-Traps

A P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block sewer gases from entering living spaces. However, if the trap arm drops vertically before reaching a vented drain line, momentum and atmospheric pressure cause the rushing water to siphon out the trap seal completely. To ensure the water seal remains intact, always maintain a minimum horizontal trap arm length before any vertical drop and connect directly to a properly sized vent pipe according to applicable local code standards.
